description: Validates a 2D Culvert project with the plugin's own Eurocode core and returns what it would build: nodes, elements, soil springs, basic load cases (traffic unit cases), the EN 1990 Annex A2 combination counts (ULS, SLS characteristic, quasi-permanent) and the nested CIVIL NX combinations, check locations, earth-pressure basis (K0 / PD 6694-1 Annex B / cl 9.4 K*) and derived geometry. Needs no model.

project.description: Changes to the 2D Culvert project (schema culvert-studio/2), merged onto the plugin's default project; arrays replace. Sections: project {name, reference, revision}; basis {profile: EN-1G | UK-1G | ..., concrete 'C32/40', steel 'B500B'}; geometry {spans [m per cell], clear_height, t_top, t_bot, t_ext, t_int, haunch_top [w,h], haunch_bot}; ground {fill, fill_density, surfacing_thk, surfacing_density, soil_density, soil_sub, phi, k0_override, subgrade (kN/m3), side_springs}; water {gw_depth, internal_depth}; earth_pressure {method K0 | annexB | cl94, fill_6n6p, ...}; traffic {carriageway, lm1, lm2, braking, surcharge, step, lm3 {enabled, sv80, sv100, sv196, gaps}, vehicles}; thermal {dT_exp, dT_con, dT_heat, dT_cool, shrinkage}; loads {sdl}; reinforcement {top_slab, base_slab, walls}; design {allowable_bearing, RH, t0, creep_phi}. Lengths m, bars [dia mm, spacing mm].

name: culvert_preview
title: Preview a 2D box culvert (Eurocode)
